name: Vail Ranch Plaza
demographics: Vail Ranch Plaza serves an affluent suburban trade area in Temecula with a median household income of $126,998 within 1 mile and $133,016 within 3 miles. The primary market consists of families and professionals with average household incomes ranging from $141,000 to $153,000, representing upper-middle-class consumers. The trade area population of approximately 78,000 within 3 miles includes households seeking convenient grocery shopping, fitness services, and everyday retail needs, with strong purchasing power reflected in the above-average income levels throughout the Riverside-San Bernardino-Ontario metro area.
description: Vail Ranch Plaza is an open-air, grocery-anchored shopping center strategically located at 32413 Temecula Parkway in Temecula, California. This well-positioned community center serves the growing Vail Ranch neighborhood with 101,766 square feet of retail space and convenient access across from Walmart. The property is anchored by three major tenants: Sprouts Farmers Market, offering organic and natural groceries; PetSmart, providing comprehensive pet supplies and services; and EOS Fitness, delivering modern workout facilities to health-conscious residents. The center's tenant mix is thoughtfully curated to include service providers, quick-service restaurants, and specialty retail shops that cater to the daily needs of the surrounding affluent community. With ample parking at a ratio of 5.00 spaces per 1,000 square feet and a prime location in one of Southern California's fastest-growing cities, Vail Ranch Plaza has established itself as a convenient neighborhood destination for families and professionals in the Temecula area.
summary: Vail Ranch Plaza is a 101,766-square-foot open-air community shopping center in Temecula, California, anchored by Sprouts Farmers Market, PetSmart, and EOS Fitness. The center serves an affluent suburban trade area with a convenient mix of grocery, service, dining, and retail tenants.
